items.html: *And now we shall explain one discourse of the discourses of AA, and it is the explanation of the three heads in it, an introduction that includes the ten Sefirot of Atzilut. And it is founded on the statement, "Three heads are engraved, one within the other, and one above the other," and it is in the Idra Zuta, page 288, and this is its language: "Three heads are engraved, one within the other, and one above the other," etc.
